ana: saw a tenant report: console shows steady v2 traffic but traces show execution on v1 during load spikes. sample id 0A1B2C3D.
fred: likely ordering: badge reads requested_version at ingress, routing may fallback after capacity check.
rachel: is this the same quota-before-route behavior we discussed? could affect billing badges.
ana: (typo) ana: yes, similar but the kicker is console badge uses a 10s sample, routing emits final tag after 30s debounce. mismatch window.
ops-bot: mitigation: flip console to prefer routed_version when present; add banner: "Badge may reflect request not execution during short probes."
eng-sre-bot: [metric] version_mismatch_ratio 0.08 for tenant ten-omega over last 5m.
fred: plan: short-term UI change + emit routed_version earlier; long-term: move quota commit post-final-route.
rachel: I'll own the UI change (ETA 90m) and a dashboard alert for mismatch >5%.
ana: thanks team, will notify CS and monitor. :thumbsup:
